title: Frame Representation Hypothesis: Multi-Token LLM Interpretability and Concept-Guided Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative and quantitative analysis using Top-k Concept-Guided Decoding to steer text generation along gender concepts (e.g., subtracting 'male' from 'woman'). The evaluation observes shifts in stereotypical attributes (e.g., family roles vs. biological traits) and measures the concept projection evolution during generation.

Evaluating the susceptibility to concept-guided steering across different languages (English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Thai) by measuring the concept relative projection and observing higher susceptibility and variance in non-European languages like Hindi and Thai.
